tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rin chen grangs sbyor ril bu'i cha lag phran bu'i dug gso thabs bzhugs so//

sman bla'i tshogs la gus btud nas// lus can rkang bzhi'i tshogs rnams kyis// sngo sa rdo chu shing la sogs// dug rigs zos pas na gyur na// sman dpyad gzhan ma ma byas pa'i// snga rol gdams pa 'di bya'o// phag khrag de wa lug ru dang*// yungs kar dbang lag sbyar ba'am// yang na re ral 'om bu dang*// yung ba phag khrag skyer shun rnams// sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdus byas la// sbyong thabs a ru mchu snyung dang*// dan rog dur byid bse ru dkar// grang sbyor ril bu bco lnga rnams// sbyar ba'i phye ma btang ba na// dug rigs ma lus sbyong bar byed// sbyangs rjes rin chen ril bu gtang*// des ni dug nad 'tsho bar 'gyur// yang na dan rog dur byid shrī khaṇḍa// spos dkar thal rdo so ma ra dzas sbyang*// sbyangs rjes rin chen ril bu cung zad bsten// 'dis ni rkyang dug ma lus 'joms par byed// sngo sogs dug chung rnams ni bsdu mi dgos// sbyangs pas chog la sa rdo chu dug rnams// cung zad bsdus te sbyangs na legs pa yin// shin tu nad tshabs che ba na// sman btang bshal sbyong khrag yang gtar// ra dug zos pa ngos zin na// bul tog a ru mchu snyung dang*// yung ba sbyar ba'i phye ma la| |oṃ trug a hri a hri kha// zhes pa ci mang bzlas la btab// chus phul btang bas 'joms par 'gyur// kun la rin chen ril bu sbyar// dug chung rnams la ser tshur gyi// khu ba blud pas grol bar 'gyur// 'di rnams mi nor khyad par med// mi yis btsan dug zos pa na// thog mar mi khyi gang rung gi// chu tshan dri chur bcas pa la// ri sho spyang tsher shu dag dang*// rgyam tshwa so 'cha' sbyar la gtang*// phub steng bzhag la drag tu bskor// skyug 'byung de nas phag khrag dang*// yung ba re ral 'om bu rnams// sbyar ba'i thang gis bsdus byas la// bsad sbyong sbrag ma'i gdams pa ni// bse ru dkar po dan rog dang*// a ru mchu snyung dur byid dang*// skyer shun gi waṃ tsandan gnyis// rin chen ril bu sbyar bas sbyong*// sbyangs pa'i rjes su rin po che'i| |ril bu zhag bdun bar du bsten// des ni nad las grol 'gyur te// dug kun ma bsdus mi gsod cing*// ma bsad mi sbyang zhes bshad do// de ltar mi shes sman pa 'gas// btsan dug rtsar byer rgyas pa la// bong nga dkar ser dmar po sogs// sbyar dug gsod pa'i sman sbyor gtong*// des ni mi sod rtsar ded nas// srog rtsar zhugs te 'chi bar 'gyur/

kha cig khrag gtar phan zhes smra// des ni rtsa la byer te 'chi// la las mar khu blud phan zer// des kyang mkhris skyed 'byer ba las// btsan dug rgyas la phan mi 'gyur// 'di 'dra'i gdams pa zab mo yang*// grang sbyor ril nag cha lag tu// dge slong dharma kīrtis sbyar// zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zab chos so// //maṅga laṃ//
